thread:
elaine (Marketing): Quick heads-up — planning to publish the benchmark blog + product launch on Tue 9:00am PT. Target: platform & ML engineers. Need embargo, legal signoff, reproducibility artifacts, and social assets.
sofia (PR): Thanks — I'll assemble the embargo list and reporter pitches today. Do we have a firm embargo timestamp? Also need a short CTO/CEO quote for the release.
matt (Engineering): Benchmark notebooks, raw logs, and scripts uploaded to s3://redwood-benchmarks/17114. Test command for reproducibility: 
```bash
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-benchmarks/17114 ./ && python run_bench.py --profile prod --runs 3
```
devon (Product): Landing page copy is ready; handing hero image and 3 social banners to design in ~1hr. Can we confirm CTA and hero copy?
claire (Legal): I'll review embargo language + any data claims. Send me the reproducibility doc link and any customer mentions.
elaine (Marketing): Embargo set to Tue 9:00am PT. Sending draft to legal and PR now. @matt can you draft 2–3 lines about latency & cost improvements for the PR?
matt (Engineering): Draft quote: "Redwood's routing + KV caching cut per-token latency by ~22% on our production traces and reduced cost-per-query by ~17% vs our previous baseline." Will tighten numbers and include confidence intervals.
sofia (PR): Scheduling reporter outreach 48 hours pre-embargo. Need exec quote from CEO — @devon can you confirm CEO availability for a quick signoff?
devon (Product): CEO is free Mon afternoon; I'll block 30 minutes for signoff.
elaine (Marketing): Social schedule = blog @ 09:00, tweet thread @ 09:05, community posts @ 09:10. Design to deliver 3 image variants + alt text. Please include 1 short (280) and 1 long (800) excerpt for socials.
jen (Design): I'll upload images and alt text to the marketing drive by EOD Mon.
deploy-bot: Post: blog-deploy started for /blog/benchmark-2024 at 2024-03-25T08:45:10Z
sofia (PR): Heads-up: TechNews may pick this up early — if they do, we should amplify and route leads to sales ops. I'll flag reporters to prioritize.
elaine (Marketing): Action items: matt finalize quote + confirm reproducibility S3 path; claire complete legal review by EOD Mon; sofia finalize embargo/reporters; devon schedule CEO signoff; jen deliver images by EOD Mon.
matt (Engineering): Uploaded final quote and reproducibility notes to s3://redwood-benchmarks/17114/docs — tests and seed data included.
claire (Legal): Reviewing now. One small ask: replace "prove" with "demonstrate" in the blog and remove an identified customer name from the appendix until customer clearance is documented.
elaine (Marketing): Noted — we'll redact the customer name until cleared. Anything else blocking?
devon (Product): All good from product. :rocket:
sofia (PR): LGTM from PR side. Will send embargo list after legal thumbs-up.
elaine (Marketing): Great work team — marking as scheduled. Ping this thread immediately if anything blocks the embargo window.
